job_spec.name: el1011-wfccrp-bb847e831-tc-hm25-pr
job_spec.purpose: fe-push-ds-1010 2026-10-10 (hardcore-1010 row dsfd_wfc_cr RISK-high, never routed): the WFC kit's credit die ports as their own tile dsfd_wfc_crp (rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_wfc_crp.sv): link-in landing in banked SRAM (ot_fifo_sram_fwft, 3 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256, DEPTH 32 >= 24 credits, 2-register output skid; replaces the 24 x 513 flop FIFO + 24:1 rp mux), DFREE credit txs (send reaches only l_valid), ot_rst_relay per clock domain (no raw rst into FIFOs), no ck<->ckv crossing. Variant hm10: HM 0.010, PD 0.40. RVT. Bench: dsrom_wfc_kit_cr_bench crp_* (kit at the real hub stages through dsfd_wfc_cr2) + LAND / DFREE / OVER mutants. | idle-sweep r2050 re-drop: c0b1a95f4 cal died in yosys (Re-definition of ot_link_credit_rx_sram: the top source dsfd_wfc_crp.sv was also in SRCS, read twice); route SDCM was a command-prefix assignment (not exported) -> export SDCM. Spec-only fix, same source. | mtp-wfc 2026-10-10: FLOORPLAN_MARGIN macro_edge root cause = auto macro placement put a landing SRAM 9.6 um from the S pin face (489 pins behind); pins on all four faces -> explicit interior macro column (fe-push 34f72883c place_macros_wfccrp.tcl). 0 cycles. | OSKID 1: registered kit-side skids (rtl_boundary in->reg 74 -> 13, reg->out 11 -> 3); +1 cycle on link in and VM write request; bench --oskid. | lineage: fe-push 34f72883c + OSKID (one lineage, main 10-11) | crp-1011: all three routes died in 4_1_cts with ODB-0370 (disconnect A of dont_touch clkbuf_0_ckv[0]): clk_net_protect (OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS) wraps repair_timing_helper after PRECTS ser_balance and marks the CTS tree dont_touch before ot_ser_balance re-hangs the ckv root; fix f7b6bea41 releases/restores dont_touch on exactly the root net + loads around the re-hang. Variant hm25: HM 0.025, PD 0.45. | PDN=pdn_view_sram.tcl (pdn_view + ot_sram_* macro grid; the default die-view PDN has no SRAM grid -> PSM-0069 at 6_report as dsfd_coll_mtp_lane). | mtp-wfc 2026-10-11 (174507588 os: TT -58.6/-62.2, FF -33): u_lo.l_data was ONE register between f_klod (N face) and t_lod (W face) -> 160 um output wire on 133 t_lod; t_klor = cnt!=0 comb to pin; f_klir -> 1,026 skid s_d enables. Fix db665a9f4: OREG kit-face skid on klov/klod (+1 cycle link out) + skid SPUSH. FF -33 = 22 ser-input D pins (hold ECO). | cc71c25a3: io_ref_routed PINFLOP-INPUT per real clock (route FF hold scene now sees the 22 ser-input D pins at -30; was +10.76 via the core pin-flop mean). | 0127f8be9: cr bench source dedupe (cc71c25a3 pair died BUILD_ERROR: re-declared ot_fifo_sram_fwft from K.EXTRA); 7/7 job bench cases verified locally. | el1011-ds-wfc 2026-10-11 STRUCTURAL (0127f8be9 TT -20/-42, all input->reg; reg->reg +102): kit valid/ready pins fanned into the W-bit skid enables (f_kswv -> 527 s_d SS -162; f_klir -> 513 out_data -98; f_klov/f_klod -> u_ks -81/-88; f_ksrv -> u_sr cnt 10 levels -52). Fix bb847e831: ot_dsrom_mtp_skid OREG 2 PIN-REGISTERED ring on all four kit faces (slot write enables from flops only, in_ready / out_valid dedicated flops, read select replicated per 32 bits -> kit pins reach <= ~20 flops) + new VM read request skid u_rq (+1 cycle VM read). FF hold = reg->port only (hold ECO).
